You would think the golden statue might have pacified Trump for a little while, but no.

I think the best part is his criticism of Todd Blanche, which goes to show that even the most willing attorney general can’t keep Trump happy for long at this point.


Harry Sisson (@harryjsisson)

Trump had one of his worst mental health episodes yet last night, posting over 55 times in 3 hours. Here is the list: 

10:15 PM - Accuses Obama of attempting a coup in 2016 
10:15 PM - Says Obama worked with CIA

Alabama asked the Supreme Court for permission to abandon court-ordered maps and go back to using ones the Court ruled were in violation of the Voting Rights Act, just three years ago, in the wake of Callais. Today, the Supreme Court said yes. open.substack.com/pub/joycev…

The Supreme Court, which ordered Alabama to create a second Black opportunity district just three years ago, has lifted that order one week before the primary. The Purcell principle says courts shouldn't permit chaos too close to an election—it's now an open question as to whether there will even be a primary on schedule.

Substack live, Tuesday at 12 noon ET: Kica Matos is the president of the National Immigration Law Center. We'll discuss law and policy as we get closer to the Supreme Court’s decision in the birthright citizenship case. You’ll have to join us to figure out the intersection of immigration law and scuba diving. You can subscribe to my newsletter for free to make sure you get a notice when we go live. open.substack.com/pub/joycev…

In a couple of years, we could be Hungary.


Alex Taylor (@AlexTaylorNews)

"I apologize to all those civilians, teachers, journalists, health workers, public figures who were stigmatized, harassed or treated as enemies simply for speaking out and standing up, for expressing a different opinion. I apologize !"

Péter Magyar in his inaugural speech 🇭🇺🇪🇺

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/AlexTaylorNews/status/2053389443927568406#m

The administrative stay in the mifepristone case ends on Monday. That means that unless the Supreme Court issues an order regarding whether the injunction should stay in place while the litigation proceeds, the Fifth Circuit’s ban on obtaining the abortion drug via telehealth goes into effect. substack.com/home/post/p-196…

This week: Gerrymandering continues, the NAACP sues, oral argument over Trump’s executive orders against law firms, & the stay in the Mifepriston case ends tomorrow. Lots to get on top of before the week starts & you can do it all here. open.substack.com/pub/joycev…

Alabama House Speaker Nathaniel Ledbetter called on the courts to overturn the 14th Amendment. Unfortunately, no one followed up to ask him which part he objected to. (Read more here: joycevance.substack.com/p/re… )

The Speaker of the Alabama House wants the courts to overrule the 14th Amendment. Listen to his exact words and understand this: We are seeing the MAGA-faction attack on our elections fully exposed this week. Now is the time to understand that and do something about it. open.substack.com/pub/joycev…

This assessment assumes typical turnout: “Republicans have roughly 10 more House seats that favor them than they did just 10 days ago.” High turnout can defeat gerrymanders. And Senate races are statewide, so this doesn’t affect them.  nytimes.com/2026/05/09/us/po…

You’ve probably had your limit at this point, please read this explanation of what happened yesterday and share it widely. It’s more important than ever to make sure people understand why we have to vote for democracy and we have to get started now if we want to be able to vote.
